stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 status [-s] [--long] [--porcelain] [-b] [--ignored]
                    [--untracked-files=<mode>] [--list-submodules]
                    [--repeat=<n>] [<pathspec>...]

Show the working tree status.

Options:
    -s, --short
        give the output in the short-format
    --long
        give the output in the long-format (default)
    --porcelain
        give the output in an easy-to-parse format for scripts
    -b, --branch
        show the branch
    --ignored
        show ignored files as well
    --untracked-files=<mode>
        show untracked files (no, normal, all)
    --list-submodules
        list submodules
    --repeat=<n>
        repeat status output every n seconds
    <pathspec>...
        limit to specific paths
